creative_direction: Create a toast-shaped robot with a warm golden crumb face and a muted violet crust. Two small dark eye slots sit above the opening, giving the robot a deadpan confident look. Add short teal feet and tiny plain side arms, with one foot stepping forward. Keep the crumb texture stylized and neat, not messy or dripping. Render the floating jam as a single precise translucent ring. Use a pale oatmeal background and a compact three-quarter view. The entire character stays within the circular avatar crop, with no kitchen scene, branding, or written symbols.
